```artifact
Feature: Hospital Staff Interaction with Information and Requirements System

  Background:
    As a member of the Hospital Staff, I should be able to interact with patient, chemist, and lab information, state requirements, provide feedback, and request revisions using the system.

  Scenario: Hospital Staff accesses the system and retrieves patient information
    In order to access patient data, chemist data, and lab results
    As a member of the Hospital Staff with system access
    I should be able to retrieve the information as an array

  Scenario: Hospital Staff states the system requirements
    In order to communicate the system requirements to Mishal and Samyak
    As a member of the Hospital Staff with system access
    I should be able to state the requirements as an array

  Scenario: Hospital Staff provides feedback on existing requirements
    In order to ensure requirements are clear and meet needs
    As a member of the Hospital Staff with system access
    I should be able to provide feedback as an array

  Scenario: Hospital Staff and Project Management and Development team use the system as a reference
    In order to utilize the system as a reference document
    As a member of the Hospital Staff with system access
    I should be able to use it as a reference and find it comprehensible as an array

  Scenario: Hospital Staff flags input for review
    In order to ensure input is flagged for necessary review
    As a member of the Hospital Staff with system access
    I provide input
    When the system flags the input for review
    Then the system should flag the input as an array

  Scenario: Hospital Staff requests to see the complete document
    In order to review the entire system documentation
    As a member of the Hospital Staff with system access
    I request to see the complete document
    When I request to see the complete document
    Then the system should display the complete document as an array

  Scenario: Hospital Staff identifies missing details
    In order to highlight missing details for clarification
    As a member of the Hospital Staff with system access
    I identify missing details
    When the system requests feedback
    I expect the system to request clarification as an array

  Scenario: Hospital Staff confirms the design meets specifications
    In order to confirm the system's design aligns with specifications
    As a member of the Hospital Staff with system access
    I am ready to confirm the design
    When I confirm the design
    Then the system should confirm the design meets specifications as an array

  Scenario: Hospital Staff requests revisions
    In order to request necessary changes to the system
    As a member of the Hospital Staff with system access
    I am ready to identify issues
    When I request revisions
    I expect the system to identify issues and request revisions as an array
```
